issue.title: bob-mac-capture typecheck-tests unsets SDKROOT and calls swiftc without -sdk, so it cannot load the stdlib on the CLT-only Mac
issue.description:
Repo: bob-mac-capture (linked). `Scripts/typecheck-tests.sh` (added in 44051a0, "fix(capture): restore pull-in builds and type-check tests") runs `unset TOOLCHAINS; unset SDKROOT` and then invokes `swiftc` directly (resolved via `xcrun --sdk macosx --toolchain default --find swiftc`) with `-target arm64-apple-macosx26.0` but no `-sdk`. On the Mac, which has Command Line Tools only, that swiftc cannot find the macOS SDK, so every invocation fails with `unable to load standard library for target arm64-apple-macosx26.0`: first the `import XCTest` probe, then the XCTest stub module emit, then each test target's typecheck.

Root cause: a missing `-sdk "$(/usr/bin/xcrun --sdk macosx --show-sdk-path)"` (or an exported SDKROOT from that path) on the direct swiftc invocations. Phase bob-cli-7k.6 confirmed the fix in a disposable scratch copy: passing `-sdk` from xcrun reaches real test compilation, and all four test targets (BobMacCaptureTests, BobMacCaptureInstallHelperTests, CaptureCoreTests, RefsCoreTests) type-check.

Proposed by bob-cli-7k.3 (note #1); corroborated by bob-cli-7k.4 (note #1) and bob-cli-7k.6 (note #3). It reproduced on clean master 060d77b, on pristine HEAD at c4b1a25, and on clean base 9b70c629 (log `.git/copy-alternates-base-tests.log` in that phase's scratch copy). Filed by the bob-cli-7k land agent. Not caused by bob-cli-7k: the script predates the epic, and the epic never touched it.

task_type_fields.impact: The AGENTS.md macOS verification gate cannot pass for any agent, so app-target test code lands without a type check until CI runs. bob-cli-7k.6 found three such test compile errors only after working around the script.
task_type_fields.location: bob-mac-capture Scripts/typecheck-tests.sh (unset SDKROOT; direct swiftc calls lack -sdk)
task_type_fields.repro: On the tailnet Mac (CLT only), rsync a scratch copy of bob-mac-capture master without .build/.git, run ./Scripts/bundle.sh and then just typecheck-tests: it fails with 'unable to load standard library for target arm64-apple-macosx26.0'. Adding -sdk "$(/usr/bin/xcrun --sdk macosx --show-sdk-path)" to the swiftc calls makes all four test targets type-check.

issue.creation_reason: AGENTS.md requires Mac agents to run just typecheck-tests before landing app Swift, but it fails on clean master. Three bob-cli-7k phases had to hand-roll an SDK workaround to type-check app tests at all.
